headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Product names

technical.usage: Price tags, specs, metadata, navigation links

usage_rules: Background must be Deep Obsidian (#050505), never pure black.
Primary Red (#D00000) used ONLY for high-impact CTAs and hover states.
Borders should be subtle (#333333) but sharp (0px radius).

layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-24, p-32. Minimum gap-8.
layout.alignment: Asymmetrical. Offset text blocks. Overlapping images.
layout.z_index_strategy: Layered depth. Text over images. Floating 3D elements.

buttons.style: Sharp edges, uppercase text, mono font.
variants: Solid: bg-white text-black hover:bg-red-600 hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300
Outline: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black

cards.style: Flat, border-only or dark bg. No shadow. 3D tilt on hover.
cards.interaction: Image scale-up on hover. Meta info reveal.

navigation.style: Floating glass or sticky solid top bar. Minimal links.

marquee.style: Infinite scroll text. Large outline font. 'RARE IS NOT FOR EVERYONE'.

principles: Parallax on images (images move slower than scroll).
Page Transition: Wipe or fade with noise overlay.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders. Visible grid lines in sections.
visual_enhancers.cursors: Custom cursor (dot or crosshair) that expands on hover.
visual_enhancers.3d_elements: Floating jacket/hoodie in Hero (React Three Fiber or Spline).

media.image_style: High contrast, flash photography, grain, moody, editorial.
media.video: Autoplay loops, muted, grayscale or desaturated.

hero.alt: Blurry avant-garde model in dark room

story.alt: Woman in black dress moody portrait

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lenis' for smooth scrolling immediately. It is non-negotiable for the luxury feel.
2. FONTS: Import 'Oswald' and 'Manrope' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts.
3. THEME: Force Dark Mode. Do not create a light mode toggle. The brand is dark.
4. LAYOUT: Use the 'Tetris' grid for the collection section. Do not use a simple 3-column grid.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components to remove rounded corners (rounded-none) and soft shadows.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. 3D: If implementing the 3D hero, use a simple R3F canvas with a floating mesh if no GLTF is available, or use the 'product_hoodie' image with a parallax depth effect as a fallback.
8. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
